The sampling interval is

\[
k=\frac{52}{4}=13.
\]

In systematic sampling, the selected numbers form an arithmetic sequence with common difference \(13\). The known sample numbers are \(6,32,45\), so the full sequence is

\[
6,\ 19,\ 32,\ 45.
\]

Thus, the missing employee number is

\[
\boxed{19}
\]
